METAL GEAR PRODUCTION FACILITY
This is Snake. Otacon, do you read me?
Loud and clear, Snake. Have you entered the facility?
I'm in the Utility Area -- the top level. Getting in was a little easier than I expected…
Well, you are the best.
Hmmmm…
Let's get down to business.
After the Shadow Moses Incident, Revolver Ocelot put Metal Gear technology on the black market.
Now every major superpower and a few minor ones are rushing to equip themselves.
Production facilities have sprung up across the globe, racing day and night to build a working model.
Sprinting towards destruction…
Precisely.
The building you're in right now is one such facility.
We need to find out as much about their production process as possible.
…Have the original plans been altered in any way?
…Have any exploitable flaws been introduced?
Look for intel, gain the upper hand.
Exactly, Snake.
Who's our source?
A scientist -- from inside the facility.
Can they be trusted?
I…don't know yet.
I know, I know… But the intel they've provided us has been reliable so far.
I'll try digging up some more information as you proceed with the mission.
Maybe you should have considered that before I infiltrated a heavily guarded facility…?
Err… Let's go through the plan again, shall we?
Right…
Your first objective is to increase your cardkey security level, granting you access to more of this facility…
To do that you'll need to find and log on to a Node. It looks like a computer terminal -- you should be able to spot it quite easily.
Log on by pressing action near the node. I'll take care of the rest.
Try to make contact with the scientist as soon as you can. They know this facility well, and can provide you with invaluable insider information.
I'm on it.
Remember, if you need any help, you can press the {pc:lsk} key at anytime to contact me via Codec.
Find that node, Snake. You've got to upgrade your cardkey security level.
Snake, a node looks just like a computer terminal.
To log on to one, get close and then press the {pc:a} key.
At that point I should be able to upgrade your cardkey security level -- that'll allow you access to more areas.
There's a guard up ahead of you…!
I can see that.
Try not to get spotted, Snake.
Remember, this is a sneaking mission -- try to keep a low profile.
The military here may be hostile, but that's no reason to go around looking for a fight.
To stay out of sight, lean against objects by pushing towards them.
While leaning against an object, edge your way towards a corner to take a peek around it.
That'll give you a chance to watch the guards' patrol routes.
If they're getting too close for comfort, I recommend using your silenced M9 pistol to tranquilize them.
Really, Otacon? Here, why don't you drive for a bit…
Please, Snake, try to take this seriously.
One of those darts carries enough anesthetic to knock out an elephant.
But the time it takes for the anesthetic to take effect is dependant on where the dart hits.
Shoot a guard in the head and he'll go down in an instant.
Shoot him in the body and it'll take a few seconds for the anesthetic to enter his blood stream.
Any more words of wisdom?
Not at the moment… Oh yeah! Always remember to wash your hands with soap and water after using the restroom…
Snake, your Soliton Radar is the single biggest advantage you have over the enemy.
Not only does it allow you to see the layout of the current room…
…it also displays any guards' field of view.
Stay out of sight, Snake. If you're spotted, the radar will be disabled for a certain amount of time.
This is a sneaking mission. Try not to attract any undue attention…
Snake, this room has a number of places where you can hide.
You can press up against both short and tall crates.
Keep out of sight.
These guys don't mess around -- they'll shoot first and ask questions later!
Snake, you need to head down to the lower areas of this facility.
I forgot my shovel -- any suggestions?
There should be an elevator down to the central floor…
But it'll probably require a higher level cardkey than the one you currently have.
Where can I find one of those cardkeys?
I doubt you can, actually.
But find a computer node, and I should be able to upgrade the cardkey you've got now.
Any luck accessing this facility's security systems?
Only the top couple of layers that describe guard protocols.
Each guard is required to check in every few minutes.
Should they fail to do so, a patrol will be sent to investigate.
There's no way to replicate this 'check-in' radio message?
Nope.
What about enemy incursion procedures?
The usual: Shoot on sight.
Lovely…
Reinforcements will be called in, too.
Avoid detection long enough for the alert level to drop…
…and the support team will be withdrawn.
Be careful though. Until recalled, guards will be extra vigilant, and search the room more thoroughly than normal.
Snake, press the {pc:a} key when facing a low object to climb up onto it.
This is a great way to bypass trouble.
Snake, let's go over your inventory.
Press the {pc:rsk} key to access it…
And any selectable items or weapons will be displayed.
Press Left or Right to select the relevant column.
Press Up and Down to select the item or weapon you want.
Certain items can be used while the inventory screen is open.
If your health gets low, try using a ration from the inventory screen.
Snake, your cardkey allows you to pass through doors with the same or lower security level.
So I have to equip it every time I want to open a door…?
No. Just having it on hand should do the trick.
If a door won't open, there's a good chance you'll have to come back to it later…
Snake, the weapon you're currently carrying is a tranquilizer gun.
It's…a little clunky to reload.
But -- used sensibly -- it should get you out of some sticky situations.
Silencer…?
The suppressor is already fitted, so it won't alert guards when fired.
Snake, if there's a gap between an object and the ground you may be able to crawl beneath it…
Look out for tables, raised pipes and vents. You should be able to use them as hiding spots.
Just face the opening and press action to enter it.
Don't worry Snake, you didn't dial the wrong egghead…
The Scientist you've been looking for had to scramble their frequency. Apparently, security has been stepped up quite a bit…
Do you think they know we're here?
Well, you haven't been spotted Snake… So it can't be us.
…I don't think so.
Something big must be going on down there in the lower areas of this facility…
So how do I reach this Scientist, anyway?
I'm going to patch you through to a frequency tuning sub-system.
From there your nanomachines will allow you to visualize -- and stabilize -- the frequency.
Think of it as a game, Snake.
A… Game?
Yes. All you need to do is follow the blue path.
The closer you keep to it, the quicker you'll decrypt the frequency.
You can use your phone camera to move Up and Down…
You can try as many times as you want, Snake.
Or -- if you're somewhere where you can't use the camera -- simply use the {pc:up} and {pc:down} keys.
Use the {pc:up} and {pc:down} keys to move.
I'm connecting you now, Snake. Good luck!
Snake, you need to tune your Codec to the Scientist's frequency.
Log on to the terminal again when you're ready to take another shot.
I'll connect you from there.
Ready to have another go, Snake?
Match the frequency by following the blue path.
Use your phone camera to move Up and Down.
You can try as many times as you want, Snake.
The {pc:up} and {pc:down} keys will work, too, if you're not in a place where you can use the phone camera.
Use the {pc:up} and {pc:down} keys to move.
Press {pc:star} to switch between camera mode and key mode.
Try to relax while you're playing.
I'm connecting you, Snake. Good luck.
Hello, Snake.
What's the matter? Cat got your tongue?
No -- I just didn't expect you to be…
A woman?
…So cute.
You flatter me, Snake.
What's a pretty girl like you doing in a place like this, anyway?
I'm an Artificial Intelligence specialist on the Metal Gear pro--
Not that I'm complaining, Dr…?
Reed. Dr. Reed.
Why turn to us for help?
I was so…naïve when I started here.
I thought my work would be used for good… To help people.
But instead it's being used to create a weapon of mass destruction.
I couldn't live with the blood of others on my hands.
What sort of payload are these Metal Gears going to be carrying, anyway?
I…don't know. The specifics of their armaments have been kept secret so far.
Where are you now?
In the Security Control Room, waiting for you.
It's one floor down from you.
Find the elevator. It'll take you to the correct floor.
What about security?
The floor you're on is lightly guarded…
Which makes for an ideal entry point.
Some of the doors have a higher security clearance than your current cardkey.
I'll upload the computer nodes' access password to your nanomachines.
With that, I'm assuming Dr. Emmerich will be able to access the system and upgrade your cardkey…
Otacon's an old pro. He's already managed to hack in, so this shouldn't be a problem.
…You trust her, Otacon?
Hard to say. The Metal Gear plans she provided us with certainly seem genuine…
But…?
But… I get the feeling that there are things happening here which are beyond our control.
Think we've got another Naomi on our hands?
I don't think so. But…don't go letting Dr. Reed give you any shots -- just to be safe.
Snake, I'm waiting for you one floor down -- the Security Control Room.
I'm going to need you once I temporarily shut down security.
I'm on my way.
I'm curious, how did you know to contact us?
You're a legend in the military community, Snake.
I always thought you were a myth, until I dug a little deeper…
…and found the man behind the myth.
The man who could help me escape.
Why are you so desperate to get out of here?
My work will be used to kill thousands… Millions perhaps.
…I cannot let that happen.
You've got to stop them, Snake. Please… Hurry!
Otacon, who exactly am I up against?
Snake, this corridor is covered by a surveillance camera. If it spots you, you'll be knee deep in trouble.
I assume the usual method will work?
Yes. Lean against the wall directly below the camera to stay out of its field of view.
Alternatively, you could use a chaff grenade to disable it.
Wouldn't that knock out my radar?
Only temporarily.
Snake, I could only get you a level 1 cardkey.
You'll need a level 3 cardkey to get through that door.
Any suggestions?
If you can access a computer node, I should be able to upgrade your current security status by one level.
…I can only do that once per node, though.
Snake this is the main entrance to the facility.
…Seems like security is tighter here than in previous areas.
This room provides access to the rest of the facility -- of course they'd keep it well-guarded..
Also, the door is connected to the security system.
If you had opened it, every alarm in the place would have gone off.
In case I need to make a quick exit…
…is there any way to shut down the alarm?
The Security Control Room has the relevant systems to do it. I'm waiting for you there.
My intel indicates that this room leads to a Utility Control Room.
Where does the other door lead to?
To an access point to the lower areas of the facility, apparently.
But you won't be able to get to it until you've upgraded your cardkey security level.
I'm on it.
Snake, when you're facing a railing you can press the {pc:a} key to climb over it and hang from the other side.
When you're hanging, you can move left and right.
Don't hang for too long though. When your grip bar is completely depleted you will fall.
Snake, I could only get you a level 1 cardkey.
You're going to need a level 2 cardkey to get through that door.
Any idea where I can find one?
Not on this floor -- I can only upgrade you to level 2
If you can get access to a computer node, I should be able to upgrade you by one level.
I can only do it once per node though. No double dipping.
Snake, you need to upgrade your cardkey.
Snake, there's an elevator on this floor that will take you down one level…
Snake, according to the plans I downloaded, it looks like there's a node in the upper right of the room.
They must use it to control the central heating and air conditioning.
If you can get access to it I should be able to increase your security clearance to level 2.
One slight hitch… There's a guard standing in the way.
You're going to have to do something to distract him.
Any ideas?
You could try knocking on a wall near the guard. He should come and investigate the noise.
That should give you a chance to slip on past.
Snake, knock on the wall to distract the guard.
Just lean against a solid object and press the {pc:a} key.
Snake, log on to that node you need to increase your cardkey security level.
Otacon, I need a password to access the terminal. Do you know what it is?
I don't, but our contact should.
I'll try to connect you via Codec.
That's weird.
What is?
The scientist's frequency has been encrypted.
Trouble?
I don't think so.
Could we have triggered a silent alarm?
Unlikely. This terminal isn't on their main security system.
We can upgrade your cardkey level from here without worry of detection.
Once we get the password.
Precisely.
Hang on a second… I've got an idea!
I've added Dr. Reed's frequency to your Codec. Press the {pc:lsk} key to open it.
Snake, you need to contact the Scientist. Press the {pc:lsk} key to use your Codec.
That's done it, Snake!
Your cardkey has been upgraded to level 2.
So I can get through all level 2 doors now?
Exactly.
You should now be able to access the area of this floor that contains the elevator.
Find that elevator Snake. It's the only way you'll get to the Scientist.
Snake… Can you hear me?
Who is this?!
We'll talk more… Soon…
Otacon, what the hell just happened? Who was that?
What are you talking about? I'm showing no record of any recent Codec communication activity…
Snake, you need to find an elevator.
It's the only way you'll be able to access the lower floors.
Snake, you're nearly there. The elevator should be in the next room.
Snake, you need to contact the Scientist.
Your Codec stores the frequencies of anyone you need to contact.
I took the liberty of adding the Scientist to your list.
Just select them in the Codec screen and press the {pc:a} key.
Snake, there's an elevator up ahead.
It should take you down into the heart of the base.
From there you should be able to make contact with the Scientist in the Security Control Room.
I don't suppose our mystery informant has given any indication of what sort of resistance to expect…?
No, but I'm guessing things'll be a whole lot hairier down there.
That's a surprise.
Snake, use that elevator to get down to the lower levels.
Get inside that elevator. It's the only way to rendezvous with Dr. Reed.
Snake, the elevator is just a few rooms away. Keep going!
Not scared of the dark, are you, Snake?
Don't be ridiculous.
Good, because air vents make great places to hide from guards.
Press the {pc:a} key when you're facing a vent to crawl inside it.
Snake, inside the elevator should be a control panel. Use it to send the elevator down to the main base.
Snake, lockers are a great place to hide from guards.
To open a locker, stand in front of it and press the {pc:a} key.
Lean against the back wall to close the door.
Press {pc:b} to switch to first person view.
Finally, press the {pc:a} key to open the door again.
Otacon, I'm…in a locker.
That's nice, Snake. Now, can we get back to the mission?
Do you remember what happened the last time you were in a locker?
…No?
You sure?
Snake, I have no idea what you're talking about.
Never mind.
That elevator will bring you down to the level I'm on.
Hurry, Snake.
Otacon, the camouflage sampler doesn't seem to be working…
Really? Let me have a look at the remote diagnostics…
I think it may have gotten banged up during infiltration…
You're right. A rough entry must have caused some of the suit's color sampling and mimicking systems to lose power.
I'm going to have to reboot the suit from here.
How long will that take?
Could be a while. Looks like it took quite a beating…
I thought you said the entry was easy?
…It was.
Just let me know when the reboot's complete.
Otacon, something's happening to the suit…
It feels like it's charging up.
Looks like the reboot fixed the problem.
If you sample a color, and then lean up against a wall of the same color, you should be hidden from any guards' sight.
However, moving will make you more noticeable.
What about surveillance cameras?
Won't work on them, I'm afraid.
